title: jurinea albescens
intro: Jurinea albescens, commonly known as the White Jurinea or Alpine Sweet Cicely, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Jurinea albescens include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Jurinea albescens include sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
